quotes.text: # Migrate to the express checkout element
Migrate your existing integration with the payment request button element to the express checkout element.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: [Payment Intents](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents.md) API to create and track payments or save card details during a payment
Listen to the [confirm](https://docs.stripe.com/js/elements_object/express_checkout_element_confirm_event) event to handle confirmation.
Listen for these events rather than waiting on a callback from the client.

findings: The new capture is a variant index, not the Payment Intents migration body: new raw lines 9-14 point to Checkout Sessions (`payment-ui=embedded-components`) and Payment Intents (`payment-ui=elements`) variants. The 579-line old capture contains the Payment Intents steps, examples, and webhook guidance. Its absence from the variant index does not establish removal or deprecation.

Current source is explicitly a Payment Intents migration summary based on the older 2026-04-21 full guide. Preserve that dated scope and its existing old raw reference; do not add the 14-line navigation index to factual raw_files or rewrite the guide as if new raw validated every historical step.

The index adds a route to a distinct Checkout Sessions API variant. This job has no captured variant body, so it cannot infer the Checkout Sessions migration steps, equivalence with the Payment Intents path, current API defaults, or changed payment behavior.

A bounded retained-source correction is required: old raw line 135 says `automatic_payment_methods` is optional in the latest API version at the guide's 2026-04-21 capture, while current source line 47 calls it 'now the API default' without a version or date. Qualify source line 47 as the old guide's API-version-specific statement; the new navigation index cannot verify today's default. This correction changes the source summary, while the 14-line index remains a route reference only and must not be added to factual raw_files.
substantive_changes: The same canonical URL now renders a 14-line selector with two explicit payment-ui variant links instead of the prior full Payment Intents guide; this is a routing/content-availability change in the captured default view, with no verified migration behavior change.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The 2026-04-21 Payment Intents variant instructed Charges API token users to migrate to Payment Intents first (old lines 10-13).

The older guide described replacing Payment Request Button with Express Checkout Element, using Elements options and `stripe.confirmPayment`, with distinct client and server steps (old lines 21-27,144-150,429-439).
The older guide recommended server-side webhook event handling rather than relying on client callbacks (old lines 567-579).

The automatic_payment_methods default claim in the older guide is explicitly scoped to the latest API version at its 2026-04-21 capture (old line 135); preserve that version and date instead of promoting it to a current universal default.
conflicts: Current source line 47 compresses old raw line 135's latest-API-version qualifier into 'now the API default'; new navigation-only raw does not verify a timeless default. The concept wiki/concepts/stripe-express-checkout-element.md line 203 calls this a 'Full migration guide' without a historical qualifier despite the new default view being a variant index.
unresolved_questions: What the two linked variant bodies currently say; only the default variant index was captured for this exact URL identity.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/elements/express-checkout-element/migration, the 2026-11-07 capture is an index at new raw lines 9-14 linking separate Checkout Sessions and Payment Intents API variants. Old raw lines 10-13 begin a full Payment Intents migration guide, so the large deletion in the diff reflects a change in the captured default view. [[source-stripe-express-checkout-element-migration]] should retain its dated Payment Intents scope rather than treat the index as evidence that migration steps were withdrawn.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/elements/express-checkout-element/migration, new raw lines 13-14 give variant routes, while old raw lines 429-439 and 567-579 supply dated Payment Intents confirmation and webhook guidance. [[source-stripe-express-checkout-element-migration]] should retain those instructions with the older raw citation, but source line 47 must qualify its 'now the API default' comment: old raw line 135 limited optional `automatic_payment_methods` to the then-latest API version. The index cannot verify today's default and belongs only as route evidence. The concept's 'Full migration guide' route should be marked historical if updated.
